mechanism_narrative: A low federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS < 4.5%) signals accommodative monetary policy, reducing discount rates and boosting equity valuations, leading to positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 55% of periods when FEDFUNDS < 4.5%.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in unemployment rate (UNRATE) by more than 0.2 percentage points in one month indicates a strengthening labor market, which typically precedes corporate earnings growth and positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 55% of periods when UNRATE falls > 0.2pp in 1 month.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous increases in housing starts (HOUST) and retail sales (RSAFS) indicate robust consumer demand and economic expansion, driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: The joint increase in HOUST and RSAFS (both rising > 0.5% MoM) does not produce positive 60-day returns in more than 55% of cases.

mechanism_narrative: During industrial contraction (INDPRO < 110), the market anticipates economic slowdown, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days as investors shift to safe havens.
failure_condition: When INDPRO < 110, SPX 5-day returns are positive in more than 55% of cases.

mechanism_narrative: Rising housing starts (HOUST) signal improving consumer confidence and economic activity, typically leading to positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 55% of periods when HOUST is rising.

mechanism_narrative: A monthly CPI increase above 0.3% (CPIAUCSL) signals rising inflation, which may prompt Fed tightening and lead to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are positive in more than 55% of periods when CPIAUCSL rises > 0.3% MoM.

mechanism_narrative: Strong job growth (PAYEMS > 100k MoM) supports consumer spending and corporate profits, driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days during labor market expansion.
failure_condition: When PAYEMS > 100k MoM, SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 55% of cases.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous increase in housing starts (HOUST) and retail sales (RSAFS) indicates a broad-based economic upturn, typically leading to positive S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: The joint increase in HOUST and RSAFS (both rising > 0.5% MoM) does not produce positive 5-day returns in more than 55% of cases.
